ingredientSections.heading: Banana and Nut Tea Syrup
items: Banana and nut tea (from specialty tea store)

methodSections.heading: Banana and Nut Tea Syrup
steps: Measure 1 part dried tea and 1 part sugar and add to 4 parts boiled water.
Add the banana and nut tea and allow to steep and cool. Strain and store in the fridge.

methodSections.heading: Nuclear Spring
steps: Combine all ingredients over ice in a cocktail shaker.
Shake until chilled and serve in a coupe glass.
